tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the AI video or image models available on AI Content Drop with their flat credit cost per generation.

tools.name: estimate_credit_cost
tools.description: Estimate the credit cost of generating with a specific model, optionally for a batch of several generations.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search AI Content Drop's published guides and model comparisons about AI video generation, prompting, and ad creative.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch the full text of one published article as markdown, by slug.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Start generating an AI video on the authenticated account. Returns a job id immediately — poll get_generation until status is 'completed'. Charges credits only on success. Call estimate_credit_cost first if the cost matters. REQUIRES AN API KEY: add "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" to this MCP ser

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Check one generation by id: status ('generating', 'completed', 'failed'), the finished video URL, and credits charged. REQUIRES AN API KEY: add "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" to this MCP server; a key is created by a signed-in human at https://aicontentdrop.com/settings/integrations.

tools.name: list_generations
tools.description: List recent generations on the authenticated account, newest first. REQUIRES AN API KEY: add "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" to this MCP server; a key is created by a signed-in human at https://aicontentdrop.com/settings/integrations.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Credit balance and plan for the authenticated account. Check this before a batch of generations. REQUIRES AN API KEY: add "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" to this MCP server; a key is created by a signed-in human at https://aicontentdrop.com/settings/integrations.
